fixes.what: compare_native.py reads the real v2 schema: parameters must be a JSON object (a pairs list is rejected with a clear error); regression test runs against the REAL x5-manifest.json fixture and asserts the comparison gets past parameter parsing

structural enforcement: x5 requires exactly 1 input, s100/s100p/s600 exactly 2; exactly 3 output heads on both sides; source and unified shapes must be unique and form a complete bijection (missing/duplicate/extra shapes all fail); per-record dtype validated against {uint8,int32,float32}, finite values checked, quantization kind/scale-length/scale-values consistency enforced; raw comparison requires identical dtypes (require_same_dtype) so a float cast can never mask a type error

identity hardening: the observer computes model/image SHA-256 at capture time (built-in SHA-256); the unified manifest's model/image hashes are REQUIRED (missing = failure) and must equal the capture-time hashes; binary hashes are computed from the attested binaries; every payload is verified against the size and SHA-256 recorded at write time on both sides; capture return_code/failed/utc_start/utc_finish recorded and checked; capture-in-progress.json and capture-error.txt markers reject the capture; target must equal build_target EXACTLY (s100 rejects s100p/s600 builds; s600 and s100p are explicit --target choices); the output preserves originals/ (both manifests + physical payloads) and digests.json over every produced file

observer hardening: all floats serialize with setprecision(17) (detection/box/scale values roundtrip exactly — asserted in tests); begin() refuses a non-empty capture directory (writes capture-error.txt, disables capture) so a stale capture can never pass; an in-progress marker is only removed by a successful finish, so early death/crash leaves a detectable state; payload writes check open/write results and fail the capture on short writes, null pointers or duplicate/unknown tensors; tensor_meta rejects negative dims/strides; dtype comes from the SDK tensorType enum on BOTH sides (S glue maps S32/F32/S8/U8/S16, X5 glue likewise; quanti never implies dtype); stdout/stderr are teed into the capture dir (best effort, failures recorded as warnings)

closure pinning: S_CLOSURE_SHA256 pins yolov5.hpp + all 7 c_utils headers + all 5 c_utils sources at 380e1a2 (verified byte-identical to the current tree, but pinned regardless); instrument.py copies the verified blobs INTO the work dir and the generated CMake references only those copies; the audit records every closure hash and work-copy path; a missing pinned commit (shallow clone) fails closed with the exact preparation command (git fetch --depth=1 origin <sha> / non-shallow clone / GitHub archive) and states that working-tree files are never a substitute — tested with a fresh repo that lacks the commit

final-coordinate comparison: the capture gains detections_original (X5 anchor inside the render loop where x1..y2 are the source's own final coordinates; S anchor right after scale_letterbox_bboxes_back); the unified adapters compute detections_original from THEIR OWN model-space detections via the SDK-free map_to_original (the exact render arithmetic, unclamped, never derived from the source); compare_native compares them under the same box criteria when both sides have them, else records an explicit not-performed stage stating that final-output equivalence is NOT claimed; the model-space nature of the main detection stage is stated in every report (identity.final_coordinate_claim)

thresholds: unchanged: inputs exact / raw atol 1e-5 rtol 0 / scale-zero exact / boxes 1e-4 / scores 1e-5 / class ids exact
